001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.control;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.bluetooth.Characteristic;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.Message;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.MessageType;
008import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.MessageProps;
009import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.models.KnownApiVersion;
010import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.models.SupportedDevices;
011import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.control.SetSleepScheduleResponse;
012import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.ControlIQSleepScheduleResponse.SleepSchedule;
013
014import java.util.Set;
015import java.util.TreeSet;
016
017/**
018 * Request message for {@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.control.SetSleepScheduleResponse}, opCode -50, size 8.
019 *
020 * <br>
021 *
022 * 
023 * <table border='1'>
024 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
025 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>-50</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
026 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>size</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>8</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
027 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>type</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>{@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.MessageType#REQUEST}</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
028 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>characteristic</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>{@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.bluetooth.Characteristic#CONTROL}</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
029 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>signed</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
030 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>minApi</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>{@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.models.KnownApiVersion#MOBI_API_V3_5}</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
031 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>supportedDevices</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>{@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.models.SupportedDevices#MOBI_ONLY}</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
032 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>response</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>{@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.control.SetSleepScheduleResponse}</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
033 * </table>
034 */
035@MessageProps(
036    opCode=-50,
037    size=8,
038    type=MessageType.REQUEST,
039    characteristic=Characteristic.CONTROL,
040    signed=true,
041    minApi=KnownApiVersion.MOBI_API_V3_5,
042    supportedDevices=SupportedDevices.MOBI_ONLY,
043    response=SetSleepScheduleResponse.class
044)
045public class SetSleepScheduleRequest extends Message {
046
047    private int slot;
048    private byte[] rawSchedule;
049    private int flag;
050    private Set<ChangeBitmask> changeBitmask;
051    
052    public SetSleepScheduleRequest() {}
053
054    public SetSleepScheduleRequest(int slot, byte[] rawSchedule, int flag) {
055        parse(buildCargo(slot, rawSchedule, flag));
056    }
057
058    public SetSleepScheduleRequest(int slot, SleepSchedule schedule, int flag) {
059        this(slot, schedule.build(), flag);
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * @param changes the fields of the schedule the pump should apply. {@link ChangeBitmask#BASE} is always added.
064     */
065    public SetSleepScheduleRequest(int slot, SleepSchedule schedule, Set<ChangeBitmask> changes) {
066        this(slot, schedule, ChangeBitmask.toBitmask(changes) | ChangeBitmask.BASE.id());
067    }
068
069    /**
070     * Replaces the schedule in the slot, flagging the fields that differ from the previous
071     * schedule (as last read with ControlIQSleepScheduleRequest), as the Mobi app does.
072     */
073    public SetSleepScheduleRequest(int slot, SleepSchedule previous, SleepSchedule updated) {
074        this(slot, updated, ChangeBitmask.between(previous, updated));
075    }
076
077    public SetSleepScheduleRequest(byte[] raw) {
078        parse(raw);
079        
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * <table border="1">
084     * <caption>Parsed fields for SetSleepScheduleRequest:</caption>
085     * <tr><td><code>slot</code></td><td><code>raw[0]</code></td></tr>
086     * <tr><td><code>rawSchedule</code></td><td><code>Bytes.dropLastN(Bytes.dropFirstN(raw, 1), 1)</code></td></tr>
087     * <tr><td><code>flag</code></td><td><code>raw[7] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
088     * <tr><td><code>changeBitmask</code></td><td><code>ChangeBitmask.fromBitmask(flag)</code></td></tr>
089     * </table>
090     */
091    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
092        raw = this.removeSignedRequestHmacBytes(raw);
093        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == props().size());
094        this.cargo = raw;
095        this.slot = raw[0];
096        this.rawSchedule = Bytes.dropLastN(Bytes.dropFirstN(raw, 1), 1);
097        this.flag = raw[7] & 0xFF;
098        this.changeBitmask = ChangeBitmask.fromBitmask(flag);
099    }
100
101    
102    /**
103     * <table border="1">
104     * <caption>Byte layout for SetSleepScheduleRequest.buildCargo(...):</caption>
105     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
106     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>(byte) slot</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>(byte) flag</code></td></tr>
108     * </table>
109     */
110    public static byte[] buildCargo(int slot, byte[] schedule, int flag) {
111        return Bytes.combine(
112            new byte[]{ (byte) slot },
113            schedule,
114            new byte[]{ (byte) flag }
115        );
116    }
117
118    public int getSlot() {
119        return slot;
120    }
121
122    public byte[] getRawSchedule() {
123        return rawSchedule;
124    }
125
126    public SleepSchedule getSleepSchedule() {
127        return new SleepSchedule(rawSchedule, 0);
128    }
129
130    public int getFlag() {
131        return flag;
132    }
133
134    public Set<ChangeBitmask> getChangeBitmask() {
135        return changeBitmask;
136    }
137
138    /**
139     * The last cargo byte: which fields of the schedule the pump should apply.
140     *
141     * The Mobi app sends BASE plus one bit for each field that differs from the schedule on the
142     * pump, and the pump then records one AaSleepScheduleChangeHistoryLog per flagged field.
143     * Whether the pump ignores a changed field whose bit is not set has not been tested.
144     */
145    public enum ChangeBitmask {
146        /** Set by the Mobi app on every request; meaning unknown. */
147        BASE(1),
148        ENABLED(2),
149        ACTIVE_DAYS(4),
150        START_TIME(8),
151        END_TIME(16),
152
153        ;
154
155        private final int id;
156
157        ChangeBitmask(int id) {
158            this.id = id;
159        }
160
161        public int id() {
162            return id;
163        }
164
165        public static Set<ChangeBitmask> fromBitmask(int bitmask) {
166            Set<ChangeBitmask> set = new TreeSet<>();
167            for (ChangeBitmask i : values()) {
168                if ((bitmask & i.id()) != 0) {
169                    set.add(i);
170                }
171            }
172
173            return set;
174        }
175
176        public static int toBitmask(ChangeBitmask... items) {
177            int mask = 0;
178            for (ChangeBitmask i : items) {
179                mask |= i.id();
180            }
181
182            return mask;
183        }
184
185        public static int toBitmask(Set<ChangeBitmask> items) {
186            return toBitmask(items.toArray(new ChangeBitmask[0]));
187        }
188
189        /**
190         * The fields that differ between two schedules, not including BASE.
191         */
192        public static Set<ChangeBitmask> between(SleepSchedule previous, SleepSchedule updated) {
193            Set<ChangeBitmask> set = new TreeSet<>();
194            if (previous.getEnabled() != updated.getEnabled()) {
195                set.add(ENABLED);
196            }
197            if (!previous.activeDays().equals(updated.activeDays())) {
198                set.add(ACTIVE_DAYS);
199            }
200            if (!previous.startTime().equals(updated.startTime())) {
201                set.add(START_TIME);
202            }
203            if (!previous.endTime().equals(updated.endTime())) {
204                set.add(END_TIME);
205            }
206
207            return set;
208        }
209    }
210}
